The task is 'do not open the locked door.' In u0, a `target_door_open` event sends the machine to u2 with reward -1.0; but if the agent has not yet seen the key (`key_found` false, u1 not reached), the trace ends. More importantly, in u0 and u1 both `target_door_open` and `target_picked_up` go to the absorbing terminal u2. No — constraints say pickup requires the door open, so every pickup implies a door opening already occurred; but in u0 a pickup can jump straight to u2 without the door-open event being separately rewarded, hiding the violation.
